rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 小泉内閣発足 states that on the afternoon of 26 April 2001 小泉純一郎 was designated by agreeing votes of both Houses as the 87th Prime Minister (56th person), formed his cabinet and that night attended the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony and the ministers' attestation ceremony at the Palace (宮中における総理の親任式及び国務大臣の認証式に臨みました), then held the first cabinet meeting late that night and issued the Prime Minister's statement, which it quotes.
